title: lathyrus laevigatus subsp. aureus
intro: Lathyrus laevigatus subsp. aureus, commonly known as Golden Pea or Yellow Pea, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include supporting cardiovascular health, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus laevigatus subsp. aureus include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve blood sugar regulation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
